title: Thunder AMRAP
description: 20-minute AMRAP: squats, wide push-ups, mountain climbers and alternating lunges

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.instructions: Run in place, heels toward the glutes

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.instructions: Lunge + torso rotation + arm toward the sky

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate rounding and arching your back, breathe

exercises.name: Squats
exercises.instructions: Feet shoulder-width apart, lower until thighs are parallel to the floor

exercises.name: Wide push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands wider than shoulder-width, focus on the chest

exercises.name: Mountain climbers
exercises.instructions: In a plank, drive knees to chest alternating quickly

exercises.name: Alternating lunges
exercises.instructions: Alternate stepping forward left and right without pausing

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Scorpion stretch
exercises.instructions: Face down, bring your foot toward the opposite hand while rotating

exercises.name: Hip flexor stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
